title: Tally per-chunk extraction
description: One JSON object per document chunk. Each of the 7 Verra VCS fields is either the string "not stated" or an object with a short value, the page it came from, and a verbatim quote (max 40 words) that contains the value.

value.description: Number with unit, date range, or one short sentence, copied as written.

quote.description: Exact sentence from the chunk that contains the value.

baseline.description: Business-as-usual scenario as a quantity (baseline emissions in tCO2e, or a deforestation rate).

additionality.description: Additionality tool/test used and its conclusion.

permanence_buffer.description: Share of credits placed in the AFOLU non-permanence buffer, in %.

estimated_reductions.description: Net GHG emission reductions/removals after leakage and buffer, in tCO2e.

x-merged-document-record: After merging chunks, each field is "not stated", {value, page, quote}, or {value: "conflict", conflicts: [candidate, ...]} when chunks disagree. scorer/score_extractions.py reads this merged form.
